historical_reviews.deepseek: YES passes the human label `TEMP CEMSlot 1~2` as one literal name, so it may not query either slot. It does not prove two stable identities, physical-to-logical PCIe slot mapping, installed add-in-card population, sensor origin, thresholds, freshness or UI correlation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires separate CEM-slot records and device mapping. V3.1 further distinguishes a board-local slot-air sensor from add-in-card internal telemetry, binds chassis slot labels to root port/BDF/FRU, and makes empty-slot behavior depend on sensor placement rather than card presence alone.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 879/2291 accepts the space/tilde operand and output presence without resolving two sensor names, CEM slot topology, installed devices, sensor source or complete threshold/UI evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify the two temperature sensors represented by `TEMP CEMSlot 1~2` are individually readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading and correctly associated with physical CEM/PCIe slots 1 and 2, with values, units, status and supported thresholds matching the platform specification.
original_method: Resolve two vendor-defined sensor records, map chassis CEM slot 1/2 through root ports to installed add-in-card FRU/BDF identities, determine whether each reading comes from a board-local slot probe or the card, and compare complete passive raw/UI fields with the approved per-slot specification under recorded population, card power/load and airflow. Preserve logs and device state.
manual_activity: The platform owner provides the chassis-to-riser/root-port/BDF/FRU map and identifies whether each CEM-slot reading is board-local or card-sourced. Automation can collect both records and UI rows separately; a human verifies physical slot/card mapping and owns the verdict. No card removal, reset or workload is authorized.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/board/riser/BMC/BIOS configuration and physical CEM slot 1/2 numbering mapped to root port and PCIe BDF
Installed/empty state plus add-in-card FRU, PN, serial, firmware/driver and power/link state for each slot
For each slot, physical sensing point and source path, stable SDR name/number/type/entity/instance and Dashboard/Server Health rows
Per-slot units, scaling/rounding, tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, freshness and empty-slot/unavailable semantics
Recorded card workload/link/power, system load, fan mode/speeds, airflow and timestamp alignment plus any approved card telemetry correlation
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, protected authentication and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or system logs; PCIe, add-in-card, thermal and BMC events are relevant identity and health context.
Do not send `'TEMP CEMSlot 1~2'` as one identifier unless the vendor documents that literal record. Enumerate and query slot 1 and slot 2 separately with individual return status.
Do not infer chassis slot numbering from BDF or enumeration order. Use the approved riser/root-port/slot map and installed FRU identity.
Do not equate board-local slot-air sensing with card-internal telemetry. Identify the source; host/vendor telemetry can corroborate only after the same card and measurement meaning are proven.
Do not remove/reseat a card, reset a PCIe device, change driver/link/power state, start traffic or accelerator load, alter fan policy or thresholds. Record existing conditions for this passive case.

Use population-aware empty-slot rules, do not truncate inventory, expose passwords through `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the unavailable Script. Stop without automatic retry on missing/duplicate/swapped slots, stale data or UI/OOB/FRU disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, chassis/riser/slot/BDF/FRU topology, sensor source, client and Script; build a two-row expected slot matrix before collection.
Retrieve the two exact CEM-slot records independently with complete SDR identity, value, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamp; capture each unchanged Dashboard and Server Health row.
Correlate every record with physical slot and installed/empty state and, if approved, time-aligned card telemetry under recorded card/load/fan/airflow conditions.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no card service, reset, driver/link/load/fan/threshold mutation, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the physical CEM slot-to-riser/root-port/BDF/FRU topology and the source/placement of both thermal sensors.
Provide per-slot threshold, tolerance, status, freshness and empty-slot acceptance plus any approved card-telemetry equivalence, and approve the tool/Script.
Review slot 1 and slot 2 independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting one slot or card-internal telemetry for a different board-local sensor.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Likely unfit because the spaced tilde expression is human range notation, not a guaranteed IPMI record, and one result cannot prove two slots. It omits topology/source/UI/spec correlation, truncates fallback output, exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate complete sensor and PCIe inventory, resolve the vendor-supported CEM slot 1 and slot 2 record names/IDs, retrieve each through protected read-only access and correlate both UI rows with the approved physical slot/BDF/FRU map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP CEMSlot 1~2, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review interprets the range without editing Master or exercising PCIe devices.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row evidence matrix keyed by chassis CEM slot and stable sensor identity, attach riser/root-port/BDF/FRU population and source metadata, then compare complete raw/API and UI fields under a recorded passive card/load/airflow state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/riser/PCIe population and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board/riser, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, card PN/serial/firmware/driver, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Chassis/riser/CEM slot topology, add-in-card inventory and thermal limits, board sensor map, SDR definition, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves range syntax into two topology-bound records and distinguishes slot-air from card telemetry while preserving the passive sensor/UI check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static CEM-slot temperatures do not validate add-in-card thermal response under load, PCIe functionality, throttling, hot-plug/reset, alarms, fan control or protection; an empty approved slot can have a board-local sensor.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Slot/BDF/FRU and sensor-source map, per-slot acceptance, card/load/airflow timing rules, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC, chassis and OS slot numbering can diverge; card and board sensors measure different locations; empty slots and UI update delay require explicit handling.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM or host/card telemetry as an approved alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/source and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent separate slot identity, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. Generic PCIe temperature or one populated card is not equivalent to both CEM slots.
expected_evidence: Chassis/board/riser/BMC/BIOS identity, physical CEM slot-to-root-port/BDF map and installed/empty card PN/serial/FRU/firmware inventory
Separate slot1 and slot2 complete raw records with stable IDs, sensor source, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamps
Separate redacted Dashboard and Server Health evidence mapped to the same physical slots and card/empty state
Per-slot Project/card specification plus recorded link/workload/power, fan and airflow state with tolerance/update-lag and optional card-telemetry comparison
Explicit empty, missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or UI/OOB/FRU disagreement disposition and pinned Script/tool security evidence
No-clear/no-write/no-card-service-or-load/no-reset/no-retry proof, final PCIe/BMC health, limitations and engineer-owned per-slot verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The range syntax is unsuitable as a literal query, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive temperature validation for CEM slots 1 and 2. Exact names, slot topology and population are Project readiness inputs rather than conflicting purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two CEM-slot temperature targets and display/specification purpose are clear. The Project can provide topology, source and acceptance data, so missing execution inputs do not make the case permanently BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed literal range query, OS enumeration or a card-internal sensor from being mistaken for two CEM-slot sensors, and prevents invasive card operations from being added to a passive display test.
independent_technical_reasoning: CEM slots are physical PCIe add-in-card positions whose chassis labels need not equal OS enumeration or BMC indices. A temperature may be measured by a board-local probe even when a slot is empty, or by the installed card when populated. Therefore each record requires a physical slot/root-port/BDF/FRU and source mapping; passive readings provide no authority for device load or service actions.
